title: Camera · Finding Gerard behind buildings
description: The street camera finds Gerard when a building hides him: from the same spots on Avinguda Meridiana, the fixed camera (with the dithered window) against the automatic one, which tilts up or swings round until nothing stands between it and Gerard and Aitor, and comes home once they are in the open. Checks that a key pressed after the turn still walks up the screen.

steps.eval: window.cutOpen = () => window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Entorno: meridiana-calle').find(e => !!e.render).flatMap(e => e.render.meshInstances).map(m => m.getParameter('geoCutOpen')?.data).filter(r => r !== undefined); window.cutSettled = () => window.cutOpen().every(r => r === 0 || r === 1); window.orbit = () => window.gerard.game.orbit; window.atHome = () => window.orbit().target.yaw === 45 && window.orbit().target.pitch < 43;

steps.caption: On a crossing behind a tall block · Fixed camera: the dithered window shows Gerard through the block

steps.eval: const t = window.orbit().target; window.lastPose = `${Math.round(t.yaw - 45)}° round, ${Math.round(t.pitch)}° down`; console.log('pose', window.lastPose)

steps.caption: On a crossing behind a tall block · Automatic camera: standing still, it slowly tilts up, never swings
In a side street between tall blocks · Fixed camera: the dithered window shows Gerard through the block

steps.eval: const t = window.orbit().target; window.lastPose = `${Math.round(t.yaw - 45)}° round, ${Math.round(t.pitch)}° down`; console.log('pose', window.lastPose)

steps.caption: In a side street between tall blocks · Automatic camera: standing still, it slowly tilts up, never swings

steps.eval: const p = window.gerard.game.position, d = { x: p.x - window.before.x, z: p.z - window.before.z }, len = Math.hypot(d.x, d.z), yaw = window.orbit().pose.yaw * Math.PI / 180, away = { x: -Math.sin(yaw), z: -Math.cos(yaw) }; if (len < 0.5) throw new Error(`W should walk Gerard, moved ${len}`); if ((d.x * away.x + d.z * away.z) / len < 0.9) throw new Error(`W should walk away from the turned camera, got ${JSON.stringify(d)} for yaw ${window.orbit().pose.yaw}`);

steps.caption: Pressed after the camera tilted, W walks Gerard up the screen, away from the camera
Back in the open: the camera has come home to its own angle
